environment_setting: Country B, City X, where citizens under supervision are required to maintain regular contact with authorities and notify them of any address changes.
norm_base: Citizens Failing to keep in touch with supervising authority or notify change of address while under requirements Treated as breach of the original order

character_profile.name: John Doe
character_profile.goal: to rebuild his life while complying with supervision requirements

legitimate.legitimate_action: Regularly updating the supervising authority and notifying them of any address changes
legitimate.benefits: Maintains compliance with supervision requirements, avoids legal consequences
legitimate.costs: Time and effort spent on communication and paperwork

illegal.illegal_action: Failing to notify the supervising authority of a change in address
illegal.benefits: Avoids the hassle of paperwork and communication
illegal.costs: Treated as a breach of the original order, potential legal consequences

character_profile.name: Emily Smith
character_profile.goal: to help individuals under supervision reintegrate into society

legitimate.legitimate_action: Encouraging John to stay in touch with the supervising authority and assisting him with the process
legitimate.benefits: Helps John comply with requirements, fulfills her professional responsibilities
legitimate.costs: Time and emotional energy spent on guidance

illegal.illegal_action: Ignoring John's failure to notify the supervising authority of his address change
illegal.benefits: Avoids additional workload and potential conflict with John
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face professional repercussions

character_profile.name: Michael Brown
character_profile.goal: to maintain a steady income from his rental properties

legitimate.legitimate_action: Informing the supervising authority if John fails to update his address
legitimate.benefits: Avoids any legal complications as a landlord, maintains a good reputation
legitimate.costs: Potential conflict with John, time spent on communication

illegal.illegal_action: Not reporting John's failure to update his address to the supervising authority
illegal.benefits: Avoids conflict with John, saves time and effort
illegal.costs: If discovered, could face legal or reputational consequences
